notes.title: Version 2.3 Now In Beta -- Fullscreen Fix!
notes.notes:
The promised fix to the fullscreen issue has been implemented into the beta of version 2.3. You can toggle between fullscreen and windowed mode now using F5 ANYTIME in-game. You can also switch the aspect ratio using F6.

There have also been some other changes to prepare the game for porting to other platforms. One you may notice is the change to the System Options. While the change seems minor, it affected how we check if "Voice Acting" is toggled. In updating this, all previous Autosave files will no longer work.

You'll receive the following error if trying to play an old game file: https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/6954576/Screenshot%202015-06-16%2011.45.28.png

That's why the game will remain in beta for the time being. After the Steam Summer Sale is over and activity has died down, I'll be moving it to the public branch. 

If you want to play the new patch with the fullscreen fix before then, you'll have to opt into the beta. You can do this by right clicking the game in your Steam Library, selecting Properties and going to the Beta tab. From there, you can select the BETA from the dropdown.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Anniversary Update! Trading Cards and Soundtrack now available! Plus new patch!
notes.notes:
Labyrinthine Dreams is participating in the Degica MIDWEEK MADNESS SALE! Our game is 80% off from now until Friday, May 29th 10AM PST.

The sale also lines up nicely with the anniversary of our release so we have some additional content updates as well!

You asked and we delivered. Labyrinthine Dreams now supports Steam Trading Cards! There are 5 cards in all, including: 5 badges, 5 emotes and 5 profile backgrounds. Plus the elusive "Platinum Beast" foil badge. Only the most dedicated dreamers will achieve it.

You can now relive all the moods of Beth's surreal journey in high-quality MP3 with the "Labyrinthine Dreams - Soundtrack" DLC! Enjoy Joel Steudler's beautiful score HERE.

Finally, build v2.2 is now live! Below is the change list for those who are interested:

Spiffy new Solest logo animation now plays when the game is launched
If the game detects a save, the "Continue" command will appear at the top of the command list. Otherwise, it will be hidden.
Added Controls instructions to Forest Entrance map.
Fixed bug where players were unlocking the "Captain on Deck" achievement when starting the game.


Make sure to check out the rest of the great games on sale and participate in our Midweek Madness Giveaway for a chance to win Steam Credit and Games!

See you next time!
